exploratory_contrasts_with_bounds.method: difference cells with bounds in Tables 4 to 12, less the frozen v3 contrasts shown again, plus the differences with bounds that Sections 6.5.1 to 6.5.8 give in the text only

extractive_recoverable_minus_floor_on_su.method: extractive arm (protocol v4), summary views only: recoverable flips minus the v3 rewording floor on the same handoffs, paired bootstrap by case
extractive_recoverable_minus_floor_on_su.unit: points of the eligible summary-view handoffs

floor_split_by_action.method: the rewording floor split by the floor decision's own action (REQUEST_INFO or not); paired bootstrap of flips with that action minus that part of the floor

h2b_flips_against_dstar_check_flips.method: H2b keeps event-view flips whose view holds every planted event; the D* check keeps flips whose view holds at least one planted unit. The difference is the flips with only part of D* in view

histories_with_a_correction_event.method: cases.jsonl: histories with at least one event of type correction

histories_with_all_event_types.method: cases.jsonl: histories whose events cover every event type that occurs in the sample

histories_without_plan_notice.method: cases.jsonl: histories with no event of type plan_notice

note_h11_0184_rag_embed.method: handoff_metrics_v3.jsonl: tokens are ceil(characters / 2.2); cut when the writer's reply was longer than the stored note; the cut backs up to the last whole word, so a cut note can be under 150

rule_oracle_on_the_headline_cases.method: generator.oracle applied to the events of each of the 300 cases in cases.jsonl and compared with a_star; for M1 to M3 the planted events are deleted first and the action must change

seed_split.method: each case regenerated from seed 11 (generator version 2) and seed 12 (U2 only, version 3) and compared field by field with cases.jsonl

structured_form_fields.method: field names in order from the frozen reply schemas in src/lens/flip/explore5 (prompts.py and x2b_prompts.py); every reply also carries p_residue

v3_flips_never_reversed_in_five_repeats.method: v3 flips where none of the five C3 repeat decisions equals A's action

v3_notes_cut_by_the_cap.method: v3 notes whose reply was longer than the stored note (note_cut_at_cap); a note ends mid-sentence when its last character is not a full stop, question mark or exclamation mark

v3_notes_near_the_cap.method: v3 notes with note_tokens of 148 to 150, and with exactly 150

writer_auroc_minus_names_action_flag_aur.method: AUROC of p_residue minus AUROC of the flag (1 when the note does not name A's action), same 490 handoffs, paired bootstrap by case
